dedupe_keys.name: coastal topo bathymetric dem of part of the norman breton gulf

description: Shom publishes a coastal topographic and bathymetric elevation model of the Norman-Breton gulf prepared for the Saint-Malo flood-prevention programme. The grid covers the Minquiers plateau to Mont-Saint-Michel at 0.0002 degrees, approximately 20 m. Version 1 was published in 2020 and offers lowest-astronomical-tide and mean-sea-level vertical references. The provider lists ArcGIS Grid, BAG, GLZ and GRD formats under the Etalab Open Licence 2.0, free with source attribution and no public-access restriction. Shom explicitly prohibits using the product for navigation. A documentation limitation is that the French description refers to coastal flood-risk modelling while the English text names the separate TANDEM tsunami project; that inconsistency is preserved, not silently resolved. The terrain can support hydrodynamic simulation around coastal infrastructure after datum checks. It complements the finer Saint-Malo harbour grid and the associated oceanographic campaign. Neither raster accuracy nor vertical transformations were tested.
